summary: Find every literal-red cell and take their bounding box. Treat every nonzero non-red cell as a marker. For each rectangle column, paint zero cells red above the rectangle unless a marker above is in that column, and independently paint below unless a marker below is in that column. For each rectangle row, independently paint zero cells left and right unless a marker on that respective side is in that row. Markers outside both rectangle coordinate bands are inert, and every original nonzero cell is preserved.
